title: The Cold Orbit
author: Edmund Reyes
blurb: Tamsin Sandoval, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
